title: Dorga to Monte Ferrante: 1435m unbroken climb, meet the lift at 2122m
terrain: Dorga (1097m) to the Colere top station (2122m) on foot, 11.9km +1435/-410. Then with the family: ridge to Vetta Monte Ferrante (2332m) and down to Rifugio Albani, 4.8km +235/-357. Lift down. Day total 16.7km, +1670, -767

steps.target: Z1-Z2 first 2km out of Dorga, 99-140 bpm
Z1-Z2 the 410m drop at km6-7, poles, short stride, 110-140 bpm
Z2-Z3 second climb km8-12 to 2122m, 145-160 bpm
Z1 regroup with the family at the top station, 95-125 bpm
Z1-Z2 ridge to Vetta Monte Ferrante 2332m, pack allowed, 120-145 bpm
Z1 descent 357m to Rifugio Albani, poles, no pack, 95-130 bpm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: out of Dorga by 06:30. 11.9km, 1435m D+, unbroken except the 410m drop at km6-7 - walk that drop, do not race it, it is the only running descent before the ridge. Reach the top station at 2122m and regroup. Then family legs: 45min up to Vetta Ferrante, 1h down to Albani. TAKE THE LIFT DOWN FROM ALBANI.
GYM: none.
FUEL, THE RANKED OBJECTIVE: 80 g/h from minute 30. 1 Isocarb C2:1 Pro per 500ml, one bottle per hour, 1 Carbo Gel at hour 2 and hour 4. Drink 125ml every 15min on the clock, not to thirst. Keep it running through the ridge legs.
STOP RULE: the 15kg goes UP only. You do not carry it on the 357m down to Albani and you do not carry it on the km6-7 drop. Lateral knee pain at any point ends the descent and you walk out.
WHY: this route trades descent for climb. 1435m unbroken is the closest rehearsal of the race opening (1900m from the gun, km0-13) you will get, but it leaves only 767m of fragmented D-, so the descent test moves to Sunday on fresh legs. Do not fix that by walking Albani to Colere - that line is ~1000m at 25% average, far steeper than the race's 12.5% final descent, and testing a harder stimulus than the race demands six days out is a bad trade.
